mapper.sql: H.HISTORY_ID, H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, H.UNIV_ID, COALESCE(U.UNIV_NAME, A.UNIV_NAME) AS UNIV_NAME, H.MEMBER_ID, H.BILLINGKEY_ID, S.PLAN_ID, P.PLAN_NAME, P.BILLING_CYCLE, H.AMOUNT, H.STATUS, CASE WHEN LOWER(B.PG_PROVIDER) = 'kakaopay' THEN 'KAKAO_PAY' ELSE 'CARD' END AS PAYMENT_METHOD, CASE WHEN H.MERCHANT_UID LIKE 'sub_renew_%' THEN 'RECURRING' ELSE 'INITIAL' END AS PAYMENT_TYPE, H.MERCHANT_UID, H.PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID, H.PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID, H.CREATED_AT, H.PAID_AT, H.FAIL_REASON, S.NEXT_BILLING_AT, S.STATUS AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, S.PENDING_ACTION, S.CANCELLATION_EFFECTIVE_AT, H.REFUNDED_AT, H.REFUND_AMOUNT, H.REFUND_REASON, H.PORTONE_CANCELLATION_ID

FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTIONS S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN UNIVERSITY U ON U.UNIV_ID = H.UNIV_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_APPLICATIONS A ON A.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY B ON B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID = H.BILLINGKEY_ID
mapper.select:
SELECT
ORDER BY
H.AMOUNT DESC, H.HISTORY_ID DESC
H.AMOUNT ASC, H.HISTORY_ID DESC
COALESCE(U.UNIV_NAME, A.UNIV_NAME) ASC, H.HISTORY_ID DESC
H.CREATED_AT DESC, H.HISTORY_ID DESC
OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT 10 ROWS ONLY

SELECT NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN H.STATUS = 'PAID' AND H.PAID_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND H.PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) THEN H.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS CURRENT_MONTH_REVENUE, NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN H.STATUS = 'PAID' AND H.PAID_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND H.PAID_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS CURRENT_MONTH_PAID_COUNT, NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN H.STATUS = 'FAILED' AND H.CREATED_AT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM') AND H.CREATED_AT < ADD_MONTHS(TRUNC(SYSDATE, 'MM'), 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS CURRENT_MONTH_FAILED_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN H.STATUS = 'READY' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS CURRENT_MONTH_READY_COUNT, NVL(SUM(CASE WHEN H.STATUS = 'READY' THEN H.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END), 0) AS READY_PAYMENT_AMOUNT FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H
SELECT PLAN_ID, PLAN_NAME FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS ORDER BY PLAN_NAME, PLAN_ID

SELECT H.HISTORY_ID, H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID, H.UNIV_ID, H.MEMBER_ID, H.BILLINGKEY_ID, B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_VALUE AS PORTONE_BILLING_KEY, B.STATUS AS BILLING_KEY_STATUS, P.PLAN_NAME, P.BILLING_CYCLE, H.AMOUNT, H.STATUS, H.MERCHANT_UID, H.PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID, H.PORTONE_SCHEDULE_ID, S.STATUS AS SUBSCRIPTION_STATUS, S.PENDING_ACTION, ( SELECT MAX(R.HISTORY_ID) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY R.HISTORY_ID ) FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES R WHERE R.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID AND R.STATUS = 'READY' ) AS CURRENT_READY_HISTORY_ID FROM SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES H JOIN SUBSCRIPTIONS S ON S.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = H.SUBSCRIPTION_ID JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_PLANS P ON P.PLAN_ID = S.PLAN_ID LEFT JOIN SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY B ON B.SUBSCRIPTION_BILLING_KEY_ID = H.BILLINGKEY_ID WHERE H.HISTORY_ID = #{historyId}
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES SET STATUS = 'REFUNDED', REFUNDED_AT = #{refundedAt}, REFUND_AMOUNT = #{refundAmount}, REFUND_REASON = #{refundReason}, PORTONE_CANCELLATION_ID = #{portoneCancellationId} WHERE HISTORY_ID = #{historyId} AND STATUS = 'PAID'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES ( HISTORY_ID, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, UNIV_ID, MEMBER_ID, BILLINGKEY_ID, STATUS, MERCHANT_UID, AMOUNT ) VALUES ( #{historyId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{univId}, #{memberId}, #{billingKeyId}, 'READY', #{merchantUid}, #{amount} )
mapper.update: UPDATE SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES SET STATUS = 'PAID', PORTONE_PAYMENT_ID = #{portonePaymentId}, PAID_AT = #{paidAt}, FAIL_REASON = NULL WHERE HISTORY_ID = #{historyId} AND STATUS = 'READY'

UPDATE SUBSCRIPTIONS SET NEXT_BILLING_AT = #{nextBillingAt}, PENDING_ACTION = CASE WHEN PENDING_ACTION = 'PLAN_CHANGE' THEN NULL ELSE PENDING_ACTION END, PENDING_ACTION_AT = CASE WHEN PENDING_ACTION = 'PLAN_CHANGE' THEN NULL ELSE PENDING_ACTION_AT END WHERE SUBSCRIPTION_ID = #{subscriptionId} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND ENDED_AT IS NULL
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO SUBSCRIPTION_PAYMENT_HISTORIES ( HISTORY_ID, SUBSCRIPTION_ID, UNIV_ID, MEMBER_ID, BILLINGKEY_ID, STATUS, MERCHANT_UID, AMOUNT ) VALUES ( #{historyId}, #{subscriptionId}, #{univId}, #{memberId}, #{billingKeyId}, 'READY', #{merchantUid}, #{amount} )
